subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book ‘Roads to Mussoorie’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**____**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ruskin Bond is an** Indian author .**
 
• **The Room on the Roof,** his debut book, was released in **1956** and was awarded the **John Llewellyn Rhys Award in 1957.**
 
• More than** 500 short stories, articles, and novels,** including 69 for children, have been written by Bond.
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi Prize** was given to him in **1992 for Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra.**
 
• In **1999 and 2014**, he received the** Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan**, respectively.
 
• The well-known author Ruskin Bond wrote** "Roads to Mussoorie"** as a tribute to the city he called home for more than forty years, Mussoorie.
